main_text.head: LECTORI CHRISTIANO,
David Blondellvs S.
main_text.p: AD fraudis, dolíque male non tam suspicionem, quam certum indicium piis animabus faciendum plus satis erat, quod in Romana communione ii, qui omnium maximè annosi videri volunt, canam ubique ac primordialem antiquitatem spirare, Patres quasi juratos sententiæ suæ vindices advocare, Protestantes novatoribus quavis data occasione accendere, iisque nova omnia (quasi nihil non nuperum sentiant) affingere amant, Methodum tam re ipsa, quam confessione propria novam jactabundi

page.notes: The opening word carries a large decorative woodcut initial "A" which is joined to the text as "AD". The first line reads "AD fraudis, dolíque male-" with the hyphenated word continuing as "li" on the next line; the transcription above corrects the broken word to "malí" as printed, with "ma-li" split across lines. Printed text on the scan reads "malí non tam suspicionem", with "suspicio-nem" split. Some letters in the first lines are faint; the spelling "accen-fere" is printed as "accensere" split across the line. Italic words: "novatoribus", "Methodum" (with a decorative initial M).
